subject: Acme SOC 2 / Audit scope - post-call recap & next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>; secops@acme.com
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Acme SOC 2 / Audit scope - post-call recap & next steps

Hi Alice / Acme SecOps team,

Thanks again for taking time today — really appreciated the thoughtful questions. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we have alignment for procurement and your security review: 

Summary of pain & goals
- Auditability: You need continuous access to API audit logs and the ability to export historical logs for the last 12 months.
- Data residency & retention: Logs and customer data must be retained for a minimum of 12 months with configurable retention windows and ability to shorten on request.
- Compliance evidence: SOC 2 Type II report, DPA, and recent penetration test summary required for security review.
- Least-privilege access: Support for scoped API keys, SSO + SCIM provisioning, and RBAC for console.

What we confirmed on the call
- Redwood provides a SOC 2 Type II report (we shared the redacted version previously).
- Audit logs: We can provide structured audit logs (JSON) with activity, request IDs, timestamps, and user identifiers; exports via secure link or S3 ETL.
- Retention: Default 12-month retention for audit logs; configurable per-account retention if you need shorter windows.
- DPA: Standard DPA available; we can accommodate additional clauses via contract in most enterprise agreements.
- Pen test evidence: We have a 2025 third-party pen test summary that we can share as a redacted PDF.

Immediate next steps (proposed)
1) I will upload the redacted SOC 2 Type II and pen test summary to a secure Drive share and send links (attached below).
2) Vivek (cc'ed) to set up a short technical follow-up (30 minutes) to review audit log schema and S3 export flow.
3) If procurement needs contract redlines, Bob from procurement (cc or separate) we can loop in legal — provide your target terms and we’ll route to our contracts team.
4) I'll open a HubSpot ticket for the security bundle (ACME-4591) so we can track evidence delivery and timelines.

Attachments (redacted stubs)
- SOC2_Report_TypeII_Q4_2025.pdf (redacted)
- pen_test_summary_2025.pdf (redacted)
- redwood_network_topology.png

If that aligns, I'll send the Drive links and schedule the tech follow-up.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0124

--
Sent from my laptop

From: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: secops@acme.com; Bob Lee <bob.lee@acmeprocure.com>
Date: 2026-05-18T17:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme SOC 2 / Audit scope - post-call recap & next steps

Marissa — thanks for the clear recap. A few clarifying Qs from our security team: 

1) SOC 2: We need confirmation that the SOC 2 Type II period covers at least the last 12 months and that the report includes monitoring controls around change management and access reviews. We will need the redacted PDF for our review.
2) Audit logs: Can you confirm the retention is configurable by account and that exports include request/response IDs, user_id, client_ip, and timestamps? We will also need a sample schema or example export.
3) DPA: Does your standard DPA include subprocessor list and data breach notification timelines? We may need a copy to share with legal.
4) Pen test: We can accept a redacted third-party summary. Are there high/critical findings open?

Also: our procurement team (Bob) will want to see contract terms and proposed SLAs. Can we get a contact on your side for legal/contract redlines?

We are targeting an internal security review by 2026-06-04, so if you can get the materials and a follow-up tech call scheduled in the next week that would be great.

Thanks,
Alice Johnson
Sr. Information Security Manager | Acme Corp
alice.johnson@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Alice Johnson <alice.johnson@acme.com>
Cc: secops@acme.com; Bob Lee <bob.lee@acmeprocure.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-05-19T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Acme SOC 2 / Audit scope - post-call recap & next steps

Alice — great questions, answered inline below and next steps at the bottom.

1) SOC 2: The redacted SOC 2 Type II we are sharing covers the period 2024-05 through 2025-11 (most recent audit cycle). It includes change management and access control testing sections. I’ve attached the redacted report (SOC2_Report_TypeII_Q4_2025.pdf).

2) Audit logs: Retention is configurable per-account; default is 12 months. Exports include request_id, user_id (or api_key id), client_ip, path, response_code, and timestamp. I’ve attached a small sample JSON export and we can also provide a nightly S3 export to a customer-owned bucket.

3) DPA: Our standard DPA includes subprocessors and a 72-hour breach notification SLA. I’m attaching the standard DPA as a PDF summary (if you want a full contract template we can route to legal).

4) Pen test: The 2025 third-party pen test summary is attached (pen_test_summary_2025.pdf). There are no open high/critical findings — the report lists a few medium items that were remediated in Q1 2026.

Attachments & links
- Drive (secure) with the full redacted bundle: https://drive.google.com/redwood-acme/soc2-evidence
- HubSpot record for tracking: https://hubspot.company/ACME-4591
- Attached to this thread: SOC2_Report_TypeII_Q4_2025.pdf (redacted), pen_test_summary_2025.pdf (redacted), redwood_network_topology.png

Next steps (action owners)
- Marissa (me): Share Drive links and attach redacted PDFs here (done).
- Vivek (redwood, cc): Please propose 30 min slots to review audit log schema and S3 export (technical call) — target next 3 business days.
- Acme SecOps: Review the documents and confirm any follow-up requests by 2026-06-01 to hit your 06-04 internal review.
- Procurement (Bob): If you want contract redlines, please send target SLA/terms; I’ll introduce our contracts lead (legal) to expedite.

If agreeable, I’ll schedule the tech call for Thursday or Friday morning PDT — Vivek, are you available?

Thanks,
Marissa
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
